'''Rajine's planet''' was a rocky [[planet]] used by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Samuro]] to imprison the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Energy Vampire|energy vampire]] [[Rajine]] and her victims. He imprisoned them in a [[Unidentified city (Rajine's planet)|city]] and raised a Force barrier over the planet to ensure that Rajine could not escape. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] defeated Rajine in the city on the planet.<ref name="No Way Out" />
